title: RELION® PRODUCT FAMILY
text:
Our first native IEC 61850 relay REF615 was part of the Relion® family of protection and control relays launched in 2009.

The Relion® family marked a major shift in how our electrical substations were built and operated. With Relion®, we moved from a mix of separate, partly incompatible relays and systems to a unified, fully digital protection and control platform. In other words, a modern product family for modern times.
funFact: It would not take long for us to reach a new milestone — a total of 1 million relays delivered. We achieved this in 2011 shortly after the Relion® family launch.

images.caption: The switching substation at Helsinki-Vantaa airport was equipped with new switchgear and advanced IEC 61850 compliant Relion 630 series protection and control relays.
The Relion family included devices for  both medium-voltage and high-voltage power systems.
The 150.000th Relion 615 series protection relay was delivered to Enerjisa Başkent Elektrik in Türkiye.
ORES reduced substation wiring costs with IEC 61850 compliant 615 series relays in the multi-functional complex of Médiacité.
